verdict.tagline: Familiar party chaos hindered by technical issues and monetization pressure.
for_you_if: you enjoy fast-paced multiplayer obstacle courses
you want a portable party game experience
not_for_you_if: you are sensitive to pay-to-win elements
you cannot risk losing account progress

distortion_flags.sentence: Sentiment peaks among early players before declining as technical and account stability issues accumulate over time.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game focuses heavily on monetization, featuring microtransactions and abilities hidden behind paywalls.

citations.review_text:
Kind of just ripped off fall guys. 
While the diversity in gameplay is fun, anything from fps shooting to water slide races to classic fall guys runs, it sure beats fall guys in that. 
Though all the micro-transactions, performance issues, and non-steam deck compatible just make it un-fun to play.
That, combo-ed with how other players act and walking off cliffs, shows that most games you play are likely just bots, making the game less skill oriented and more about making you getting engaged to spend more money.
the game is very good but nowadays it focuses more on money than the experience

This game is very hungry for money, adds new skins that nobody asked for.
Same with adding countless of abilities mainly hidden behind a paywall.
It was still a pretty fun game nonetheless
very fun game but a bit pay to win
Its not the best, not the worst. A little racing game full of micro transactions.

claims.claim: Reviewers report losing their main game accounts and progress entirely.

citations.review_text: But I Lost My Main Account of the Game.

HEAVY AVOID

I had a LOT of skins, emotes and abilities until I tried to play on April 1 2026 and my account had seemingly been deleted and I lost EVERYTHING

I thought it was an April Fool Joke but nothing came back

Feels like a classic rug pull

Learn from my issues

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the battle pass and items previously obtainable with earned currency now require real money purchases.

citations.review_text: I wouldve given this game a good review, i love the game, it was better then Fall Guys ever was. I love it to the core, but it was soo much better when it was 2020, now, 6 years l8r, it sucks rlly a lot, this game has lost its charm to greed, i used to be able to get rlly cool skins via sinking hours upon hours into this game, and i played around the launch. it was such a good game, with awesome ♥♥♥♥ in it. but now, you cant even get anywhere in ranked without any p2w abilities they added. The battle pass used to be able to be obtained via gems, which i didnt do but now i wish i surely did. rip one of the best free games.

Game was cooler when everything WASN'T behind a paywall. Only we the players can get them to change this back. Start review bombing them, don't buy into the paywall stuff. If it can work for other games, it should work for this one too! NO MORE PAYWALLS!!!
With the recent update where you have to spend real money instead of gems for the stumble pass the game has gone downhill. Used to grind tournaments for the stumble pass but now its impossible

Since the latest 0.99 update the games gone to trash. Most things cant be bought with Gems anymore, and the new UI is complete garbage. When I did try to buy the Stumble pass it told me to activate my in-game overlay which it already was. I tried talking with support but that's practically non-existent. It was fun while it lasted.
